hero.label: Headless commerce · WordPress + Next.js
hero.body: Catalogue, orders, stock, accounting, delivery, couriers, a drag-and-drop page builder and every local payment method — one platform, deployed to your own Vercel project in a single click.

platform.label: The architecture
platform.title: Headless, without the integration project
platform.body: Most headless builds mean stitching a CMS, a commerce API and a frontend together yourself. ComboStore ships all three as one platform — and deploys them as a single Vercel project.
platform.oneDeploy: Storefront and dashboard in one deploy

wordpress.title: WordPress
wordpress.desc: Your team works in the editor it already knows. The ComboStore plugin adds the commerce models, roles and a REST layer on top of it.

api.title: ComboStore API
api.desc: Order logic, stock sync, payment rails and delivery routing run through one API layer — the storefront never touches the database.

storefront.title: Next.js storefront
storefront.desc: Server-rendered category and product pages, incremental revalidation, and a checkout that still works on a slow connection.

modules.label: Everything included
modules.title: Twelve modules. One dashboard.
modules.body: No per-module licence and nothing to switch on later. Every module below is included in every plan — read down them, or search the whole platform at once.

search.label: Search features
search.emptyHint: Try a shorter word, or clear the search to browse by module.

catalog.name: Catalogue
catalog.desc: Build the catalogue once. Variants, brands, tags and reviews all live beside the product, and AI drafts the description while you are still uploading photos.

orders.name: Orders
orders.desc: Every order from placed to delivered — including the ones that never finished checkout, which is usually where the next day's revenue is hiding.

inventory.name: Stock
inventory.desc: Live counts with a full history behind them, so you can see what sold, what was adjusted and what is about to run out before a listing goes dark.

insights.name: Insights
insights.desc: The numbers you actually act on — what sold, who is buying again, and what your staff changed — without exporting anything to a spreadsheet.

accounting.name: Accounting
accounting.desc: Purchases, supplier invoices and running costs sit in the same place as the sales, so margin is a number you can read rather than a number you work out.

delivery.name: Delivery
delivery.desc: Your own riders and the courier companies side by side, with zones and rates that decide what checkout charges.

people.name: Team
people.desc: Everyone who touches the shop gets exactly the screens their job needs — managers, support agents, suppliers, riders and affiliates included.

builder.name: Page builder
builder.desc: Build landing pages, product templates, headers and footers by dragging blocks. The Tailwind classes are generated with them, so nothing drifts from the rest of the site.

content.name: Content
content.desc: A blog for the SEO traffic you are not paying for, a media library for everything you have shot, and an assistant that writes the first draft.

support.name: Support
support.desc: Questions and complaints in one queue with the full order history attached, so nobody has to ask the customer what they bought.

payments.name: Payments
payments.desc: Every method your customers already use, configured in the dashboard — no plugin stack to license, wire up and keep in sync.

integrations.name: Integrations
integrations.desc: Pixels, analytics and maps are settings rather than code edits — and when something is missing, an extension adds it.

builder.label: Page builder
builder.title: Design the storefront without a designer
builder.body: Drag blocks onto the page and the Tailwind styles come with them. Start from a template, or describe the section you want and let AI lay it out.

ai.title: AI section generation
ai.body: Describe a section and the builder lays it out with real elements and matching Tailwind classes — then you edit it like anything else you dragged in.

ai.label: AI, built in
ai.title: Let AI write the first draft, every time
ai.body: Give the assistant a few details and it drafts a product description, a blog post, or a whole page section — ready to edit and publish from the same screen.

wordpress.q: Do I need to know WordPress?
wordpress.a: No more than you already do. The admin is the WordPress editor your team can learn in an afternoon, and every commerce screen — orders, stock, delivery — is built by us on top of it.

hosting.a: On your own accounts. The storefront is deployed to your Vercel project and the admin sits on your WordPress hosting, so the data and the domain stay yours. Those two bills are separate from your plan.

domain.q: Can I use my own domain?
domain.a: Yes — the onboarding wizard adds it to the Vercel project for you, and the storefront serves it as soon as the DNS resolves.

payments.q: Are the payment gateways really included?
payments.a: The integrations are. You still open your own merchant account with bKash, Nagad, SSLCommerz or whoever you choose, and their transaction fees are theirs to charge — we take no commission on your orders.

migration.q: Can I move an existing shop over?
migration.a: Products, categories and customers come across by bulk upload, and the Business and Enterprise plans include help doing it. Tell us what you are on now and we will tell you honestly how much work it is.

ai.q: What does the AI actually write?
ai.a: Product descriptions, SEO titles, blog posts and page sections. Every draft lands in the editor for you to change, and nothing publishes on its own.

cta.title: Your shop, live in days — not months
cta.body: Point it at a domain and deploy. We will walk you through setup, migration and payment configuration.
